name: Kusunoki Minoru
source:
He is an ordinary young man who can be found anywhere.

He has no father, but he has lived a slow life with his mother without worrying about that.

However, due to a reunion with Akane, who is said to be his birth mother, and a breakdown of trust with Tomoe, he loses the “reality” inside him after repeated changes in the truth.

Within the protagonist, something that had been suppressed until now comes to the surface.
